text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On the way back from an outing, I
decide to
accompany Mejiro Bright on a
shopping trip.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your patience! Your
company is
very much appreciated.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Bright says this after picking out
and
purchasing a bottle of perfume
almost
immediately after entering the
shop.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
This perfume is a French classic that's
been
adored by many for a long time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
The bottle's lid is modeled after a bird in
flight,
and it's just so elegant and
adorable that—
Heya, Bright! ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
My! Good day to you, Maruzen. What a

coincidence.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Are you two out shopping too? ...Wait a
sec. That
bag...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
What a coincidence! I was just shopping
at the
same boutique! Look!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Goodness gracious... Did we happen to
purchase
the same item, Maruzen?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Will you look at that! We did! I'd
recognize that
box anywhere!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I had no idea you were such a trendy
lady, Bright!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! This perfume's all the rage with
the groovy
youths right now! I only
found out about it myself
recently.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I see... Well, I have heard quite
effusive
praise for it since it came into
vogue.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: You've "heard"? Hold the phone there, Bright. What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
This is a gift for my mother. I thought it
might be
nice to send her a little
something along with my
usual letter.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, gotcha! That's such a thoughtful gift
for your
mother, Bright!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...She gave me the time and space to
develop at
my own pace during my
youth, all while patiently
watching over
me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
That held true when I set my sights on
the
racetrack as an Umamusume of the
Mejiro family.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Ryan and Dober guided me, and my
mother was
there to give me a gentle
push forward.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Why, if it weren't for my mother's
efforts, I
wouldn't be racing here at
Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Wow... Your mother sounds like a
wonderful
person.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Teehee. Still, what a wonderful
coincidence it is
that you wear the same
perfume as my mother,
Maruzen. ♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Wha?! Y-yeah, it is! Sounds like me and
your
mother might really hit it off...
Ahaha...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I believe so too. Should the opportunity
arise, I'd
love to introduce you to one
another.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
W-well, um... I hope we'd have stuff to
talk
about, what with, you know, with
the generation
gap. ...Do you think she'd
like Italian chow?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Italian... "Ciao"? I'm not sure. Shall I
inquire?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The conversation continues, and the
more
similarities we find between
Maruzensky and
Mejiro Bright's mother,
the livelier everyone gets.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of which, this has just occurred
to me,
but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
You always order tiramisu, Maruzen, and
my
mother often partakes of it as well.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
No way! Really?! Cool beans! You know
what? I
think I got it figured out!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Bright, your mother really lives in the
now! She's
totally clued in on all the hip
trends!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"Clued in..." Why, yes! She is quite
perceptive.
Thank you. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I don't have the heart to step in and
address the
breakdown in
communication, so I just keep quiet
and
listen.
